services/cluster/sdk_test.go: 1
`507-520`: **📐 Maintainability & Code Quality** | **🔵 Trivial** | **💤 Low value** **The test does not verify the user-visible refusal text.** Line 519 asserts on the package-level `errNoLeader` constant, not on the error that `WriteRefusal` returns. This assertion always passes. Capture the error returned by the survivor and assert on it.
Proposed fix ```diff - require.Eventually(t, func() bool { return errors.Is(survivor.WriteRefusal(t.Context()), errNoLeader) }, 10*time.Second, 50*time.Millisecond, - "the survivor turns the push away") - assert.Contains(t, errNoLeader.Error(), "nothing was written") + require.Eventually(t, func() bool { return errors.Is(survivor.WriteRefusal(t.Context()), errNoLeader) }, 10*time.Second, 50*time.Millisecond, + "the survivor turns the push away") + assert.ErrorContains(t, survivor.WriteRefusal(t.Context()), "nothing was written") ```
The test uses real timeouts. The retrieved learning prefers `testing/synctest` for timing-dependent tests. The SDK engines use real I/O, so `synctest` does not apply cleanly here.
